projects.name: Loadster Logistics Platform
projects.description:
A real-time logistics platform connecting businesses and verified drivers through two production Flutter applications. Built with scalable architecture, Socket.IO, Google Maps, background location tracking, and enterprise-grade logistics workflows.

Loadster is not a single mobile application. It is an enterprise logistics ecosystem consisting of two production Flutter applications: Loadster (Customer / Shipper) and Champion (Driver).

Both communicate together through REST APIs, Socket.IO, Google Maps, Live GPS, and Backend Services to manage a real-time order lifecycle.
responsibilities: Designed and developed two production Flutter applications.
Integrated Google Maps and live GPS tracking.
challenges: Maintaining persistent GPS tracking in the background across heavily customized Android OS versions (MIUI, ColorOS) without getting killed by battery optimizations.
Handling real-time Socket.IO disconnections and state recovery gracefully during spotty mobile network conditions.

architecture.description: Clean Architecture with GetX for predictable state management. Native Android foreground services ensure persistent real-time GPS tracking even when the app is terminated.

subProjects.name: Loadster
subProjects.description:
Loadster enables businesses and customers to book trucks, create shipments, track deliveries in real time, communicate with drivers, manage invoices, and simplify logistics operations through a modern Flutter application.

Built as a broker-free platform, it serves as a business-friendly enterprise tool that scales with user needs, offering complete shipment management, real-time order monitoring, and seamless driver interactions.
responsibilities: Designed and developed the Flutter application.

architecture.description: Clean Architecture with GetX for predictable state management, coupled with a modular layout of reusable components. Built on a repository pattern ensuring high-performance communication with the backend.

subProjects.problem: Businesses often struggle with finding verified trucks, maintaining shipment visibility, managing manual coordination, tracking deliveries efficiently, and communicating clearly with drivers during transit. The lack of a unified digital logistics system causes delays and operational friction.

subProjects.name: Champion
subProjects.description:
Champion empowers verified truck drivers to receive shipment requests, accept trips, navigate routes, share live location, update delivery status, upload proof of delivery, and manage their logistics workflow through a real-time Flutter application.

It operates as a comprehensive driver management application featuring real-time dispatch, route navigation, earnings management, and enterprise logistics operations.
responsibilities: Developed the complete Flutter driver application.

architecture.description: Built with a modular architecture and GetX for clean state management, the application guarantees production-ready code. Foreground Android services run natively to persist background location tracking reliably.

subProjects.problem: Drivers consistently face challenges such as finding consistent delivery jobs, managing multiple shipments efficiently, sharing live locations, and relying on manual communication. Navigation difficulties, status updates, capturing proof of delivery, and tracking trip earnings manually lead to significant operational friction.

projects.name: SmarDen Platform
projects.description:
An ecosystem of Flutter applications spanning smart-building automation, real-time IoT control, and B2B electrical-product distribution — built around reusable technology and white-label deployment.

SmarDen is not a single isolated mobile application. It is an enterprise multi-product technology ecosystem consisting of two core production Flutter applications: SmarDen Prime (Smart Building & IoT Automation) and Smarden Network (B2B2C Electrical Products & Partner Network).

Both platforms leverage shared architectural foundations in Flutter and Dart, connecting distributed hardware devices, local protocols, real-time cloud brokers, and complex B2B commerce workflows while powering multiple branded OEM deployments.
responsibilities: Led core Flutter application development across the SmarDen multi-product ecosystem.
Architected feature-first codebases utilizing GetX MVC (controllers, bindings, reactive UI) over resilient service layers.
Implemented real-time WebSocket communication and token authentication for IoT device control.
Engineered multi-protocol connectivity including TCP/LAN discovery, BLE device onboarding, and Zigbee gateway interactions.
Built complex enterprise workflows in Smarden Network: partner onboarding, quotations, order lifecycles, and commission attribution.
Integrated comprehensive Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) supporting client, partner, and administrative interfaces.
Developed dynamic runtime organization branding and module configuration enabling white-label OEM releases.
Ensured high-performance responsive UI, memory efficiency, and rock-solid production stability across Android and iOS.
challenges: Orchestrating dual communication paths: instantaneous local LAN control (raw TCP/BLE) for sub-50ms latency alongside resilient cloud WebSocket synchronization for remote access.
Designing an organization-driven dynamic theming and module enablement system without runtime performance degradation or layout regressions across low-end mobile devices.
Managing complex multi-role state transitions (Electrician, Architect, Distributor, Admin) in SmarDen Network with strict client-side permission enforcement and offline resilience.

architecture.description: A unified platform architecture engineered in Flutter and Dart. The presentation layer employs GetX MVC with reactive controllers and bindings over a shared service layer. High-frequency IoT interactions leverage token-authenticated WebSockets and direct LAN protocols (TCP/BLE/Zigbee), while enterprise commercial operations stream through structured REST services with role-based access control.

projects.solution:
The same core technology is adapted and deployed as branded applications for different OEM and enterprise partners. Instead of rebuilding the entire application for each partner, a centralized foundation combines:

• Reusable Core Engine: Shared communication, device discovery, state management, and real-time synchronization.
• Tenant & Organization Configuration: Dynamic runtime branding that adapts display name, logo assets, primary/seed color palettes, and operational modules per organization.
• Multi-Protocol Hardware Layer: Universal device abstractions compatible across diverse branded hardware catalogs.
• Branded Applications: Seamless OEM deployments that maintain dedicated customer-facing brand identities while guaranteeing rock-solid production stability.

subProjects.name: Smarden Network
subProjects.description:

Smarden Network streamlines complex electrical supply-chain relationships into a structured digital ecosystem. Built with GetX reactive architecture, the platform accommodates distinct presentation shells for client transactions, partner management, and native administrative verification.
responsibilities: Developed complete Flutter application architecture for the B2B2C network platform.
Engineered GetX controllers, bindings, and services spanning 30+ registered routes and 99 Dart files.
Implemented partner registration, OTP-based phone authentication, and administrative verification flows.
Built structured project requirement submission and dynamic multi-version quotation workflows.
Developed end-to-end order processing, payment receipt proof uploads, and administrative verification.
Implemented transparent commission calculation, payout attribution, and ledger history.
Integrated comprehensive client-side Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) supporting 5 distinct user roles.
Built dedicated administrative modules for partner auditing, quotation adjustments, and dispute handling.
Connected ~75 REST endpoints via Dio with robust token management, error interceptors, and caching.
Delivered responsive layouts ensuring smooth usability across varied smartphone and tablet screen sizes.

architecture.description: A multi-role enterprise Flutter architecture utilizing GetX reactive state management. The app encapsulates distinct workflow domains with role-based access control, communicating across ~75 REST endpoints with token authentication and structured caching.

workflow.description: The end-to-end B2B partner distribution and commission pipeline.

subProjects.problem: The electrical distribution and contractor ecosystem in India operates largely through unorganized offline channels: handwritten requirement slips, verbal price quotations, unverified manual payment receipts, and disputed commission tracking. Electricians, architects, and distributors face immense friction in quoting accurate prices, managing order fulfillment, and verifying payment transactions transparently.

projects.name: Nutmeg Buyer Platform
projects.description: A wholesale procurement marketplace connecting buyers with suppliers, enabling catalog browsing, order management, bidding workflows, supplier communication, and payment processing.
responsibilities: Built catalog browsing and product discovery workflows.
Integrated Stripe payment processing and invoice generation.
Developed real-time supplier communication using Socket.IO.
challenges: Managing complex local cart state with offline support and synchronizing it with the server upon reconnection.
Implementing secure and seamless 3D Secure payment flows within the app using Stripe.

architecture.description: Clean Architecture with Bloc/Cubit for robust and predictable state management. Segregated into Domain, Data, and Presentation layers.

projects.problem: B2B wholesale buyers lacked a unified, mobile-first platform to discover suppliers, manage large catalog orders, negotiate bids, and process enterprise-scale payments securely. Traditional methods relied on fragmented emails, spreadsheets, and manual invoicing, leading to high friction, delayed payments, and poor order tracking.
projects.solution: Engineered a comprehensive Flutter-based B2B marketplace application using Clean Architecture and Bloc/Cubit for scalable state management. The solution integrates a dynamic catalog browsing experience with complex local cart state management that handles offline scenarios and server synchronization. Integrated Stripe for secure, 3D Secure compliant enterprise payments and automated invoice generation. Built a real-time bidding and negotiation system backed by Socket.IO for instant supplier-buyer communication.
projects.results: Successfully launched a production-grade marketplace that processes high-volume B2B transactions. The robust Bloc architecture reduced state-related bugs by 40% and improved application performance during heavy catalog browsing. The integrated Stripe flow decreased payment processing time, and the real-time bidding system increased buyer-supplier engagement significantly.
